title: Linguistics Specialists
description:
Role Title: Linguistics Specialists
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote (US and Western Europe)
micro1 is engaging Linguistics Specialists to contribute expertise to a customer project focused on language model evaluation. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters.
Scope of Work

• Carefully review and analyze conversations between humans and large language models (LLMs) for accuracy, clarity, and completeness.

• Examine and assess responses generated by LLMs against well-defined instruction-following guidelines.

• Provide detailed, constructive written and verbal feedback regarding model output quality.

• Identify subtle errors and inconsistencies in grammar, usage, and context, ensuring linguistic precision.

• Deliver succinct, actionable feedback with meticulous attention to detail, focusing on accuracy rather than creativity.

• Document findings and recommendations in clear, organized reports to support ongoing model improvements.

• Collaborate with project coordinators to clarify guidelines and address ambiguities in tasks as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

• Native proficiency in U.S. English (required for this engagement).

• Advanced academic background or extensive professional experience in linguistics, language analysis, or related fields.

• Demonstrated expertise in written communication, with the ability to deliver nuanced linguistic assessments.

• Strong generalist skills as a writer and linguistic specialist, with exceptional attention to language detail.

• Ability to provide both written and verbal insights clearly and professionally in English.

• Availability to begin contributing immediately upon selection.

• Experience with guideline or rubric-based evaluation preferred, though not required.

title: QA/DevOps Engineer
description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

We are seeking a QA/DevOps Engineer to join Discord’s Business Systems team. In this role, you will own automated test suite development and maintenance across Oracle ERP Cloud (Fusion) and Salesforce, with a focus on Tosca-based regression and progression testing. You will embed automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and partner closely with ERP Functional, Technical, and DevOps teams to ensure every release is tested consistently and defects are caught early.

What you'll be doing

• Run Oracle ERP Cloud and Salesforce QA automation suites for all quarterly patch upgrades end-to-end.

• Review new Oracle and SFDC release features and recommend improvements to existing testing processes.

• Build and improve regression and progression test automation in the Tosca environment for Oracle Fusion and Salesforce.

• Create, maintain, and update Tosca scripts to reflect system and process changes across GL, AP, AR, and FAH modules.

• Lead feature enhancement reviews as part of quarterly patch assessment cycles and new enhancement projects.

• Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines; trigger regression suites automatically on every release candidate build.

• Maintain test infrastructure and environments in collaboration with DevOps and ERP Technical teams.

• Document test coverage, defect trends, and release readiness in Jira and shared reporting dashboards.

Automation Use Cases

• FAH Process Automation: Auto-test Financial Accounting Hub on each new sales item addition to eliminate manual unit testing.

• AR Regression Suite: Automated flows for invoicing, receipts, and customer setup across every release.

• AP Regression Suite: Payment runs, supplier invoices, holds, and approvals tested automatically on each patch cycle.

• Salesforce Tosca Automation: Develop, maintain, and expand automated SFDC test suites in Tosca, integrated with release pipelines.

What you should have

• 3-5+ years of QA automation experience.

• Hands-on Tosca experience for regression and progression test suite development and maintenance.

• Experience executing and maintaining automated test cycles for quarterly Oracle patch upgrades.

• Familiarity with Oracle ERP Cloud and SFDC release feature review and technical impact assessment.

• Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or equivalent).

• Familiarity with pipeline configuration: triggering regression runs on pull requests and release candidate builds.

• Working knowledge of version control (Git / GitHub or GitLab): branching, pull requests, and code review workflows.

• Basic scripting capability in Python, Shell, or PowerShell for test utility automation and pipeline support.

• Understanding of containerized test environments (Docker); experience running tests in ephemeral containers is a plus.

• Jira for defect tracking, test coverage reporting, and sprint participation.

• Experience writing and maintaining test documentation: test plans, test cases, regression logs, and release readiness summaries.

• Ability to work cross-functionally with ERP Functional Analysts, ERP Technical Developers, and DevOps engineers.

• Familiarity with SOX compliance, ITGC controls, and ERP change management practices.

Preferred Qualifications

• Oracle Fusion certification or formal training in Oracle ERP Cloud modules.

• Experience with SaaS QA automation in a high-growth technology company environment.

• Exposure to OIC (Oracle Integration Cloud) or MuleSoft integration testing.

• Familiarity with Salesforce test automation frameworks

Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place!

E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life.

As Program Supply Chain Manager, you will own the end-to-end Supply Chain / Procurement execution function - from subcontract formation / piece part purchase through to delivery performance and cost control - while providing direct program support across our active spacecraft & terminal development efforts.
 
This is a hands-on, early-career role. You will own the full supply chain and procurement function: from raw material sourcing and supplier qualification through purchase order execution, material planning, logistics, and delivery of finished goods. There is no hand-off - this product line is yours.
 
You will work directly with Engineering and Supply Chain team on the floor and in the system. If you want a desk job, this isn’t it. If you want to build something and own it, read on.

This is a full time, exempt position, based out of our Arlington, TX office.  The target base pay for this position is $100,000 - $120,000 annually.  The total compensation packaged will be determined by various factors such as your relevant job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.  We are redefining how satellites are designed, manufactured and used-so we’re looking for candidates with passion, deep knowledge and direct experience on LEO satellite component development, design and in-orbit activities. If that’s your experience - then we’ll be immediately wow-ed. E-Space is not currently able to provide employment sponsorship for candidates who do not hold work authorization for the location of this role. 

Why E-Space is right for you:

As a member of our team, you will play a crucial role in driving our success.  Our team members have a strong sense of dedication and responsibility; this includes a strong commitment to our mission to create an entirely new suite of global capabilities to improve lives, business efficiencies and build a smarter planet. This means that there will be times when extra hours, including nights and weekends, may be needed to meet critical deadlines and mission goals.  In return, we offer a dynamic work environment with opportunities for professional growth and development and the chance to make a meaningful impact in a high-growth industry.  

We want you to make the most of your journey at E-Space. That’s why we support and invest in the physical, emotional and financial well-being of our team members and their families. Some of what you can expect when working at E-Space:

title: Partner Marketing Manager, Launches
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

This is a partner marketing role that demands product marketing craft. You'll be the single-threaded owner of how every Claude launch lands on partner marketing surfaces. We reach many of our most important customers through our partners. When we ship a new model or capability, it doesn't just launch on first-party surfaces; it launches across our growing partner ecosystem, each with their own product pages, blogs, seller enablement, and go-to-market motions. Our product release cadence has accelerated, and we're looking for someone to own that translation end-to-end.

Model and capabilities launches are the core of the job and the majority of the work. The rest is solution launches - the joint and co-built solutions that land on partner surfaces alongside our models. The two halves reinforce each other. Model launches create the moment; solution launches translate what’s possible for the sellers and customers on the other side.

You'll be the first dedicated owner of launch readiness across our partner surfaces, consolidating work currently spread across several people and creating a center of excellence for how we do this work. This role centralizes launch coordination for our partners - briefing partner teams under confidentiality, shaping how our positioning shows up on their surfaces, and orchestrating execution cross functionally. You'll be the person who knows exactly what's available on which surface, how we're messaging it, and how it all fits together. You will use this knowledge to ensure our launches are positioned for the highest impact and amplification across our partners.

The job is roughly half launch execution and half building. On the execution side, you'll run the launch playbook. On the building side, you'll define what we haven't had the bandwidth to create yet. You'll set the standard for how Anthropic shows up on partner surfaces and hold the rest of the company to it, without anyone involved reporting to you.

Anthropic reaches a substantial share of its customer base through partner surfaces, and the ecosystem is still growing. How Claude shows up on the platforms where enterprises actually buy AI is largely unwritten. This is the role that writes it.

Responsibilities

•
Own partner launch readiness end-to-end, serving as the directly responsible individual for every model, feature, and solution launch across the partner ecosystem - from the first briefing through launch-day go-live and reach reporting

•
Define the operating model for partner launches: set the standard for what readiness means, decide what's durable enough to share and when, and own the trade-offs when timelines and partner needs conflict

•
Equip partner sellers and solution architects to position Claude for a customer workload without escalating to us - segment-specific enablement, technical content, and the materials their field actually reaches for

•
Translate Anthropic positioning for partner surfaces, taking source messaging from Product Marketing and creating partner-specific versions that account for what's available where, what each partner needs to hear, and how the narrative lands on their platform

•
Own the go-to-market motion for joint and co-built solutions on partner surfaces - position what a partner and Anthropic have built together, make the value legible to that partner's sellers and customers, and land it across the channels where their buyers look

•
Work with Partnerships, Product, and partner-side teams to shape solutions into launchable moments, and make the call on which are worth a launch at all

•
Run launch execution - Manage cross-functional review cyc

title: Front End Engineering Manager, Firefox Desktop
description:
Why Mozilla ?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission - to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders - only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

The Firefox team is a community of engineers who care deeply about delivering the fastest, friendliest, most usable browser possible. We are responsible for making the things you see in the browser work securely, quickly, and well! Working in the open is the norm, and we contribute to the code driving the Firefox browser on a number of desktop platforms - Windows, Linux, and macOS. Our focus is on implementing and fixing things in Firefox as well as helping other teams make it excellent for our users.

A Frontend Engineering Manager directs a team of geographically distributed engineers to constantly drive improvements to Firefox Desktop experience through innovations and enhancements to the browser user interface in Firefox. We need a leader who is dedicated to building exceptional teams, creating innovative solutions, delivering quality software, and influencing how the world uses the internet.

Feel good about your work again! Pursue your future while working to protect the future of the internet for everyone, everywhere.

What you’ll do:

• Drive initiatives to deliver value to our users ensuring the software your team delivers is high quality, highly available, monitored, and maintainable.

• Help the team navigate trade-offs and drive alignment in a fast-paced field; balancing quick delivery with thoughtful, long-term approaches across a portfolio of user experiences in the browser.

• Communicate your team’s goals, the scope and risks of your projects, and own the delivery of initiatives on clear timelines.

• Identify, build and iterate on engineering processes that support a high performing team.

• Engage regularly 1-1 with your team to discuss both technical work and professional development; provide direct and honest feedback about their individual performances

• Ensure developers are properly supported and empowered throughout the developer lifecycle.

• Create an inclusive environment which engages and challenges your team members.

• Work collaboratively with many teams including Product, UX, QA, Operations, and Data Science.

What you’ll bring:

• 4+ years leading engineers in a software development environment and working across multiple distributed teams.

• Software engineering background that empowers you to drive technical decisions within the team and engage with engineers at all levels of seniority to triage, prioritize and implement.

• Experience leading multiple concurrent projects.

• Previous experience working on frontend platform initiatives e.g. design systems and frontend architectural improvements.

• Track record of delivering front-end experiences to user-facing products

• Hands-on experience with web technologies (JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS).

• Proven track record successfully leading and shipping sophisticated user facing experiences on time, using data to inform timelines. .

• Strong communication and ability to develop positive relationships with others, regardless of their rank or role.

About the Role
As an Appeals and Grievances Specialist, you'll own the end-to-end handling of member and provider appeals and grievances, investigating cases, coordinating with internal teams, and delivering clear, well-reasoned resolutions within regulatory timelines.
This role sits at the intersection of advocacy, compliance, and operations. You'll work directly with members and providers who need someone to take their concern seriously, dig into the details, and get them an answer they can trust. You'll report to the Director, Quality and Continuous Improvement, and work closely with QA, Claims, Clinical, and Provider Relations to reach fair, well-documented outcomes.
What You'll Do

• Intake, triage, and manage a caseload of member and provider appeals and grievances from submission through resolution

• Maintain accurate records in the case management system to support audits and regulatory reporting

• Contribute to process improvements, SOP updates, and knowledge base articles for the appeals and grievance’s function

What You'll Bring

• Bachelor's degree required, in a relevant field such as healthcare administration, business, public health, or a related discipline

• 3+ years of experience in appeals and grievances, claims adjudication, utilization review, or a related health insurance operations role

• Working knowledge of health insurance regulatory requirements for appeals and grievances (state DOI requirements, ERISA, ACA as applicable)

• Strong analytical skills, comfortable reading claims data, plan documents, and clinical notes to form a defensible conclusion

• Excellent written communication skills; able to explain complex determination in plain, empathetic language

• A track record of managing a caseload independently and meeting hard deadlines

• Comfort working across systems and teams to track down the information a case needs

• A member-first mindset, balanced with rigorous attention to policy and compliance

Nice to haves

• Experience with Genesys Cloud, Salesforce, or similar case management and CRM platforms

• Familiarity with Medicare Advantage or ACA marketplace appeals processes

• Prior experience in a fast-growing or start-up health insurance environment

What You'll Get

• Competitive salary ($65,000 - $75,000), bonus opportunity, and equity package

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• A 401k retirement plan

• Paid vacation and company holidays

• Opportunity to make an impact at a rapidly growing mission-drive

title: Sr Customer Success Executive

HealthEdge 's customer success strategy depends on four organizational capabilities: achieving customer outcomes, retaining and converting referenceable customers, expanding revenue within the existing customer base, and maintaining data and reporting integrity. The Senior CSE is the primary delivery vehicle for all four.
This is not a relationship management role. It is an outcome ownership role. A Senior CSE at HealthEdge is accountable for the promise between what a customer bought and what they are getting - and for resolving customer issues before they become an escalation, a churn risk, or a missed expansion opportunity.

We're building the infrastructure, tools, and talent to make every business in our portfolio AI-native. We're hiring across 150+ vertical market software businesses in the Valsoft portfolio. Engineers at Valsoft go where the hardest problems are - embedded directly inside portfolio companies, working alongside operators, product teams, and customers to solve complex, messy, high-stakes challenges that can't be fixed from a distance.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Construction Electrician, you will install and terminate new electrical infrastructure: substations, medium-voltage distribution, feeders, and building electrical. This is a build job, not an operating-plant job - pull, land, and energize new equipment from drawings, then turn it over. You will follow lockout/tagout and grounding procedures and support first energization and switching on medium-voltage systems up to 161 kV. This position is based in Memphis, TN.

• Document work performed, test results, and as-built markups.

• Operate company vehicles and specialized equipment; inspect and store personal protective equipment (PPE).

• Perform similar or less skilled incidental duties as assigned.

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

• 3+ years of experience working as a licensed electrician.

• Medium-voltage electrical experience, including switching and operations.

• Associate degree in electrical, mechanical, or industrial maintenance technology.

Le ou la candidat(e) idéal(e) possède

- Un atout : une expérience en IA conversationnelle ou en orchestration de modèles de langage, y compris des technologies vocales comme Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Whisper ou OpenAI Realtime

- Un atout : une connaissance pratique des plateformes de téléphonie infonuagique ou CPaaS telles que Twilio, Amazon Connect, Genesys ou LiveKit

As a QA Lead, you will be responsible for overseeing the quality assurance process and ensuring that our products meet the highest standards of quality and reliability. We are seeking independently licensed behavioral health professionals to contract with us to provide Behavioral Health Care Management services for adult oncology patients through a Collaborative Care Model.

Minimum commitment: 20 hours per week.

Applicants will be considered for both immediate and future openings that align with their experience. Candidates may be contacted as opportunities arise, and timelines for next steps may vary based on business needs. We appreciate your patience and look forward to connecting.

• Provide behavioral health care management services to adult oncology patients.

• Conduct behavioral health screenings and clinical assessments.

• Deliver brief evidence-based behavioral health interventions.

• Educate patients regarding behavioral health conditions and treatment options.

• Monitor patient progress and treatment response.

• Experience collaborating with physicians

• Passion for quality behavioral health care

• Strong communication skills

We help people with cancer improve their quality of life by providing behavioral healthcare to the 17 million cancer patients in the US as an extension of their medical treatment.

We are on a mission to provide relevant, accessible behavioral health at the point of care that is embedded within a patient’s oncology practice. We are backed by a premier venture capital firm and are building a world-class team of clinicians, technologists, and healthcare operations builders passionate about helping cancer patients improve their quality of life.
We have built a behavioral health services and technology company to support patients' mental health alongside their physical health treatment plans. Our first offering deploys virtual mental health services using Collaborative Care, an evidence-based behavioral health care model. We will scale this virtual care model using technology, and build the foundations to drive outcomes focused on value-based care.

IDRA is a national nonprofit organization whose mission is to achieve equal educational opportunity through strong public schools that prepare all students to access and succeed in college. Since 1973, IDRA has brought research, policy expertise, community knowledge and legal advocacy together to advance the civil rights of students and families.
IDRA seeks to expand the capacity and impact of its legal team to protect students’ rights amid rapidly changing state and federal education policy. We are looking for a dynamic staff attorney to engage in legal advocacy alongside families, young people, community advocates, attorneys and organizational partners working to advance education justice.
The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience in movement lawyering, community lawyering or other community-centered approaches to legal advocacy. • Monitoring high-impact education law developments in state and federal courts and agencies and assessing their implications for students, families, schools and communities

• Supporting and expanding IDRA ’s coalition amicus advocacy, including identifying strategic cases, conducting legal and factual research, drafting briefs, coordinating amici and working with counsel and community partners

• Conducting legal intakes and coordinating referrals involving education-related civil rights issues and identifying patterns that may inform broader legal, policy or community advocacy

• Developing legal strategies in partnership with affected communities, recognizing students and families as experts in the systems and conditions that affect their lives

• Creating and presenting know-your-rights trainings and accessible legal resources for students, families, educators, advocates and community organizations

• Researching and drafting model education policies designed to protect students’ civil rights and promote safe, welcoming and equitable schools

• Training and coordinating volunteer attorneys, law students and community advocates supporting IDRA ’s legal advocacy

• Providing legal counsel to IDRA ’s policy and advocacy teams, including analyses of legislation, regulations, agency actions and emerging legal issues

• Supporting community-centered responses to civil rights violations, including identifying administrative, policy, litigation and other advocacy strategies that may provide relief to individual students while addressing systemic problems

• Representing IDRA in state, regional and national coalitions dedicated to civil rights, education justice and strong public schools

title: Senior Ads Designer
description:
We're looking for a Senior Ad Designer to own performance creative production end to end for a fast-moving performance marketing agency running 30 active accounts across B2B and B2C. You will take approved copy briefs and turn them into finished, on-brand, production-ready static ad sets across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and Reddit - without a creative director having to fix details behind you.
This is a performance role, not a brand role. A plain ad with a sharp idea beats a beautiful ad that does not convert, and that is always the call we make. You will be designing for multiple accounts simultaneously, each with its own brand system and hard rules, and you will be expected to catch your own errors before anything goes to review. If you are a senior designer who understands the feed, works cleanly inside someone else's brand system, and produces batches that arrive at review ready to be judged on the idea rather than the execution, this role is a strong fit.
Why You'll Want to Join

• You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)

•
Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy

• Observance of Holidays per company guidelines

•
100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive

• This role requires overlap with US business hours

• Work across a diverse portfolio of B2B and B2C performance marketing accounts with real creative volume

• High-ownership design role where your output directly drives paid media performance across 30 active accounts

What You'll Work On
Static Ad Production

• Take approved copy briefs and design full ad batches in Figma from brief through production-ready delivery

• Design across multiple accounts simultaneously, each with its own brand system, rules, and creative standards

• Resize every batch across all required formats including square, 4:5, 9:16, and 1.91:1 for each channel

• Run the client's QC checklist yourself before anything goes to review - every account has one and you own it

• Flag when a brief is thin or unclear rather than guessing and absorbing the cost quietly

Figma File Management

• Build files other people can actually work in - named layers, real text layers, components where they make sense, exports set up correctly

• Maintain clean, organized Figma files that a creative director or another designer can pick up without confusion

• Work within established component libraries and brand systems without drifting from them

AI-Generated File Handling

• Some briefs will arrive with an AI-generated first pass attached - treat it as a reference, not a draft to polish

• Nothing in an AI-generated file is pre-approved and elements may be off-brand even when they look finished

• If the file is not editable enough to work with, rebuild it and flag it in the ticket - we need to know whether the workflow is saving time

Project Tracking and Communication

• Keep your work current in the project tracker including stage, delivery date, and review owner

• Communicate proactively when timelines are at risk or briefs need clarification

• Participate in two to three review rounds per batch - notes on concept and direction are expected, notes on font sizes and typos are not

What You Bring

• Proven senior-level experience designing static performance ads for paid channels including Meta, Google, LinkedIn, or Reddit

• Strong understanding of what makes an ad stop the scroll and make the offer legible in under two seconds

• Demonstrated ability to work inside multiple brand systems simultaneously without drifting from any of them

• Figma at a real working level - auto layout, components, variants, clean export setup, and files other people can use

• Meticulous attention to detail with the ability to catch your own errors before review

• Comfortable taking direction from a creative director without needing every decision made for you, and able to push back when a brief is wrong

• Comfortable working with AI tools as part of the production workflow

title: Reliability Engineer
description:
Prioritize candidates with medical device or regulated hardware experience, strong background in reliability engineering, HALT/HASS/ALT, and statistical modeling (Weibull, lognormal).
Technical Evaluation - Assess expertise in DFMEA/PFMEA, fault tree analysis, accelerated life testing, DOE, and use of data tools (Minitab/JMP required; Python/Matlab/R preferred).
Regulatory Knowledge - Verify familiarity with ISO 13485, ISO 14971, FDA 21 CFR 820, EU MDR/IVDR, IEC 60601, IEC 62304, IEC 62366‑1, ISO 10993, and ISO 17025.
Responsibilities:
Additional responsibilities for this position are as follows:
Working with R&D, quality assurance and manufacturing teams to develop reliability requirements (including requirements cascade), develop and implement comprehensive reliability test plans for IVD medical devices that align with product development and production processes.
Developing reliability plans and requirements, leading and facilitating Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA).
Designing and developing test methods and fixtures to assess the performance and durability of IVD devices.
Writing test protocols, training personnel on test procedure, analyzing data and creating final reports.
Conducting reliability tests and documenting results, including environmental, lifecycle, and accelerated aging tests, to evaluate product performance under different conditions and in compliance with relevant regulatory standards and guidelines.
Analyzing test results and providing detailed reports, identifying areas for improvement and potential risks.
Serving as the subject matter expert and technical representative for the reliability engineering function in project teams.
Recommending design or test methods and statistical process control procedures for achieving required levels of product reliability.
Leading and directing multiple projects in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
Participating in design reviews and working with engineering to drive DFR (Design for Reliability) process and tools and support in defining and executing reliability plans.
Reviewing device failures, performing root cause investigations, and documenting results in a failure reporting, analysis, and corrective action (FRACAS) system.
Compiling and analyzing performance reports and process control statistics; investigating and analyzing relevant variables potentially affecting product and processes.
This position may suit you best if you are familiar with the following:
You have a deep understanding of design for reliability and reliability engineering.
You have a working knowledge of regulations and best practices for medical device development such as ISO 13485 and 21 CFR 820 as well as IEC 61010, IEC 60601, IEC 62506, IEEE 1413 and IEEE 1332.
You can generate data and perform life data analysis.
You have knowledge of building fixtures and performing Life Data Analysis for in-vitro diagnostics medical products.
You can manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks effectively.
You can communicate effectively with other engineers, managers, and stakeholders.
You have a demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and collaborate with technical teams and drive results. 
You can identify and solve complex problems related to design for reliability.
You can analyze data and identify patterns to develop solutions for potential problems.
You have a strong understanding of engineering principles and are familiar with relevant software and tools.
You can identify and assess risks that can cause delays to project timelines or increase project costs.
You can develop process and methodology to model system and subsystem reliability.
You can work with development teams to drive effective FMEA's and risk reduction.
Required skills to have for the success of this role.
Bachelor’s degree (Advanced degree preferred) in Mechanical /Electrical /Reliability Engineering or related discipline.
10+ years reliability engineering experience in highly regulated industry prefer

title: Associate Director, Payments/Scheme Economics
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide - including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more - with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/us/operating-principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for an Associate Director, Payments/Scheme Economics to own the integrity, visibility and management of Airwallex’s payment costs, starting with card scheme fees and interchange fees across Visa and Mastercard.

Reporting to the Head of Strategic Finance, you will be the subject matter expert on scheme economics, translating complex and rapidly changing network rules into accurate system configurations, financial outcomes and business decisions. You will ensure we understand what every payment should cost, that those costs are accurately reflected across our systems and financials, and that we systematically identify opportunities to improve payment economics as we scale.

Over time, the remit will expand across other card schemes, local payment methods and the broader payments cost base.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own scheme economics and rule interpretation: Maintain deep expertise across scheme fees, interchange and network rules. Interpret scheme bulletins, operating regulations and fee schedules, translating changes into clear financial, product and operational requirements.

- Ensure accurate payment cost configuration: Translate complex scheme rules into fee tables, eligibility criteria and transaction-level logic. Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure cost calculation, allocation and customer billing accurately reflect current network rules across markets and payment flows.

- Protect payment cost integrity: Establish robust governance, testing and controls across scheme configurations. Reconcile expected costs against actual network charges, identify anomalies and leakage, and drive root-cause resolution.

- Build granular visibility into payment economics: Develop robust models and analytics across markets, products, payment methods and transaction types, creating a clear view of unit economics, margin drivers and cost movements.

- Drive structural cost and margin optimization: Identify, quantify and execute opportunities to improve economics through transaction qualification, BIN routing, cost configuration, and other levers. Partner with Product, Finance and Commercial teams to prioritize the highest-value opportunities.

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.
